text:
Elaine P: Heads-up — Partner X is ready to submit marketplace security artifacts. Need a quick ops/security handoff: SOC2, pen-test, questionnaire, and artifact upload path. Who can own TTL/retention and presign flow? :wave:
Mark G: I can coordinate with Partner X on collection. Do we have a checklist to send them?
Priya S (Security): We require SOC2 Type II (latest 12 months) OR completed SOC2 bridge letter. Pen-test: either a 3rd-party pentest report within last 12 months or a scheduled pen window + remediation attestation. Sensitive logs should be redacted.
Elaine P: Perfect. Also partner asked about how long presigned links remain valid — they want a one-click upload. Ops prefers shorter TTL.
Tamir K (Cloud Ops): Recommend presign TTL = 7 days (604800s) max. We can do 24h for high-risk artifacts. Bucket path: s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/partner-x/<artifact-type>/
Jorge R (SI): For SI integrations we also need firmware attestation and an inventory manifest (csv). Can we create separate folders so we can map owners?
Mark G: I'll send them a zip request with naming conventions. Can someone paste the official checklist link?
Priya S (Security): Use this internal checklist: https://redwood-internal/docs/marketplace/compliance/checklist (link for partner-facing doc). Key items: SOC2, pen-test report or vendor plan, vulnerability scan summary, inventory manifest, redaction log, contact person + PGP for any private keys.
Elaine P: Owners: Mark -> partner coord & uploads; Tamir -> presign TTL and S3 policy; Priya -> acceptance criteria for redaction + pen-test scope; Jorge -> SI artifacts + attestation. Deadline: partner asked for 2-week turnaround. Can we commit?
Tamir K (Cloud Ops): 2 weeks ok for presign + bucket setup. I'll create a short runbook for them with AWS CLI commands.
Tamir K (Cloud Ops): Example presign command to share:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/partner-x/pen-test.pdf --expires-in 604800
```
Use --expires-in 86400 for 24h.
Priya S (Security): On pen-test scope: must include internet-facing endpoints + auth flows. If they used a managed service, we accept the vendor report plus our checklist confirming no PII exposure. Also need vulnerability severity matrix and remediation ETA.
Jorge R (SI): For firmware attestation, partner must provide signed manifest and SHA256 checksums. We'll validate on our side.
Mark G: I'll draft the email + checklist and ping the partner today. Assigning tasks in Notion.
Elaine P: Quick question on retention: partner wants us to keep artifacts for 5 years for auditability. Do we have a retention policy that long?
Priya S (Security): Default retention is 1 year in S3 IA, extendable to 7 years for enterprise customers with proper justification and compliance packaging. For marketplace listing, 3 years is typical — need legal signoff for 5.
Tamir K (Cloud Ops): Technically ok to set lifecycle to 7 years if Security & Legal approve. We'll mark as conditional.
Mark G: Action items: 1) Send checklist + naming conventions (Mark) 2) Create presign flow + runbook (Tamir) 3) Review incoming SOC/pen artifacts (Priya) 4) SI attestation validation (Jorge) — target: partner upload in 10 business days.
Elaine P: Thanks. I'll loop in Legal for retention exception. Also will request partner to encrypt artifacts client-side (PGP) if they can.
AuditBot: Automated reminder — vendor-artifact-deadline set for +10 business days from thread creation.
Priya S (Security): One more note — redact any tenant/customer PII from logs. We can provide a redaction checklist snippet if helpful.
Mark G: Please drop that snippet, Priya. I'll attach to the outgoing email.
Priya S (Security): Redaction snippet: remove IPs, emails, account IDs; replace with hashed placeholders; preserve timestamps and event type. Example: user_email -> <redacted_email_sha256>.
Elaine P: Great — I'll send in 30m. Thanks all :thumbsup:
